intel.title: [CISA KEV] MLflow MLflow - MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-64849
廠商: MLflow
產品: MLflow
漏洞名稱: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
說明: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-02
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA 將 CVE-2026-64849 納入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV），該漏洞存在於開源機器學習生命週期管理平台 MLflow 中，屬於伺服器端請求偽造（SSRF）漏洞。攻擊者可利用此漏洞存取內部或雲端元數據服務，並獲取敏感的回應狀態與內容。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
